purpose: Machine-readable fast routing for one canonical main integration world. Stable state is metadata/artifact identity; parallel is a delivery alias.

directories.src: canonical editable source/evidence grouped by module
directories.runtime: machine-readable active runtime metadata, task coordination and verified fast indexes
directories.artifacts/runtime_cache: content-addressed exact DLL bytes for stable packaging and rollback
directories.artifacts: recovery, binary audits and deterministic reproducers
directories.archives: deprecated/intermediate archive experiments; do not scan by default
directories.tools: verification, build, packaging and maintenance scripts

rules: main is the canonical integration/development trunk
parallel is an exact compatibility/delivery alias and is never an independent development authority
work is legacy compatibility/history and is not the default branch for new tasks
ordinary new work starts on short-lived feature/** from current main
read compact startup/routing state before module source and do not enumerate all branches on the success path
broaden analysis only for concrete unresolved ownership, conflict, provenance, verification or recovery risk
normal multi-file changes should be one Git tree commit
the serialized queue revalidates against live main and atomically updates main plus parallel
post-integration delivery is fail-closed path/risk routed; unknown or mixed runtime changes require STANDARD
heavy repository-wide audits are scheduled/manual/PR/release and not part of every micro-iteration
PREFLIGHT PASS is not TEST READY; exact integrated-SHA delivery/package gates are authoritative
STABLE packages use exact accepted bytes, never an unchecked rebuild
stable state is baseline/artifact metadata, not a permanent branch role
release candidates use promote/** and exact-SHA pre-promotion plus explicit stable packaging
never mix TBC/Wrath/Retail assumptions into build 5875 code
inspect successful jobs/steps/logs only when a specific decision requires them

verification.method: compare snapshot git_blob_sha1 values with Git tree metadata from the same live main HEAD

eligible_tasks: ordinary implementation from canonical main through feature/**
CI/status follow-up where startup authority files are unchanged
full_startup_required_for: editing any startup source file, snapshot or generator
recovery after unknown or ambiguous write/transport state
snapshot missing, stale, mismatched or unverifiable
authority ambiguity not resolved by compact state
after_verified_snapshot: resolve current main HEAD before creating/writing a feature
read only module/dependency files needed for the task
implement before broadening analysis unless a concrete risk is unresolved
invariants: parallel is an exact delivery alias
work is not a normal development target
one logical iteration uses one coherent commit when possible
never force-push or destructively reset unique work
fast startup never weakens exact-SHA runtime, package, provenance or release verification
heavy audits stay outside the ordinary hot path
branch/history/archive archaeology is failure-driven, not default
